summary: GMEX Robotics Corp filed a Form 6-K announcing a 1-for-7 Class A and 1-for-28 Class B share consolidation, effective May 1, 2026, to reduce outstanding shares and meet Nasdaq listing requirements. No shareholder approval was needed. Post-consolidation, Class A shares drop to 858,157 and Class B to 7,188. The company remains listed under symbol GMEX. This is a routine capital structure adjustment, not a special situation.
